findings.claim: `CONFIG_NAMES` is no longer exported, which breaks any in-repo or external importer of this constant.
findings.rationale: This was a public module export; `constants.ts` is typically re-exported via Vitest's node/config entry points and consumed by the CLI, UI, and editor integrations for config-file discovery. Removing the `export` is a source-breaking change that won't surface when compiling this file alone (only `configFiles` uses it locally), so any remaining importer fails elsewhere. Medium-high confidence this needs a repo-wide grep before merging; it is safe only if no other module imports it.

findings.claim: `CONFIG_EXTENSIONS` is no longer exported, potentially breaking importers that enumerate supported config extensions independently of `configFiles`.
findings.rationale: Separate symbol from CONFIG_NAMES with its own likely consumers (e.g. code that validates/resolves a user-supplied `--config` path by extension rather than using the precomputed `configFiles` list). Those call sites cannot be satisfied by `configFiles` alone, so this de-export may leave them without a replacement. Confidence is moderate — depends on actual usage in the tree.
